pending_commit.commit_message: UPSTREAM: ASoC: topology: ABI - Add PCM Support and bump ABI version to 4 The struct snd_soc_tplg_pcm_dai is renamed to snd_soc_tplg_pcm. This struct will now be used to handle data related to PCMs (FE DAI & DAI links). It's not for BE, because BE DAI mappings will be provided by ACPI/FDT data. Remove the unused struct snd_soc_tplg_pcm_cfg_caps. We are using snd_soc_tplg_stream and snd_soc_stream_caps instead. Bump ABI version to 4. Signed-off-by: Vedang Patel <vedang.patel@intel.com> Signed-off-by: Mengdong Lin <mengdong.lin@intel.com> Signed-off-by: Mark Brown <broonie@kernel.org> Link: git://git.kernel.org/pub/scm/linux/kernel/git/broonie/sound.git br: for-next (cherry picked from commit 5b2688a59af686f7c0a80edc49d7f190365ac090) Signed-off-by: Vedang Patel <vedang.patel@intel.com> BUG=None TEST=with the whole series applied, audio works on SKL. TEST=there are no regressions observed on BSW. CRAS: transport - Don't use blocking call to release transport For some BT speakers not sending correct disconnect event when powers off, sending 'Release' method for a2dp transport could take 6 seconds to timeout and reply. This blocks CRAS main thread for a while not switching to new output node, and freezes video playback. Fix this problem by using the non-blocking dbus call to send release message. We don't need to wait for reply from bluez to close the transport. BUG=chrome-os-partner:45103 TEST=a2dp playback with 'Jam classic' BT speaker, power off speaker and verify audio transfer to internal speaker in 5 seconds. Change-Id: I60e0be4e5f78cec51fb61e5417eefb15de82b679 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/318094 Commit-Ready: Hsinyu Chao <hychao@chromium.org> Tested-by: Hsinyu Chao <hychao@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Cheng-Yi Chiang <cychiang@chromium.org>
